import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;   // v = target, r = reverse index
        long f, c, p; // f = current flow, c = capacity, p = cost
        Edge() {}
    }

    static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
    static int[] sz;
    static long mc;

    static void init(int n) {
        mc = 0;
        sz = new int[n];
        adj = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
        mc = Math.max(mc, c);
        Edge e1 = new Edge();
        e1.v = b; e1.r = sz[b]; e1.f = 0; e1.c = c; e1.p = p;
        Edge e2 = new Edge();
        e2.v = a; e2.r = sz[a]; e2.f = 0; e2.c = 0; e2.p = -p;
        adj[a].add(e1);
        adj[b].add(e2);
        sz[a]++;
        sz[b]++;
    }

    static boolean[] vis;
    static int[] par;
    static long[] pot, dist;

    static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        if (sparse) {
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((x, y) -> Long.compare(x[0], y[0]));
            pq.add(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] top = pq.poll();
                int u = (int) top[1];
                long d = top[0];
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c) {
                        long nd = d + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        if (nd < dist[e.v]) {
                            dist[e.v] = nd;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            pq.add(new long[]{nd, e.v});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                vis[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c) {
                        long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        if (nd < dist[e.v]) {
                            dist[e.v] = nd;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;
        long df = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
            df = Math.min(df, e.c - e.f);
            u = r.v;
        }
        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
            e.f += df;
            r.f -= df;
            price[0] += df * e.p;
            u = r.v;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
        }
        return df;
    }

    static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        vis = new boolean[n];
        par = new int[n];
        pot = new long[n];
        dist = new long[n];
        price[0] = 0;
        long flow = 0;
        long df;
        while ((df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)) > 0) {
            flow += df;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int nodes = n * T + 2;
        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        init(nodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                long cost = (long)((j+1)*(j+1) - j*j); // = 2j+1
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, nodes, true);
        if (flow != k) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Assertion failed: flow != k");
        }
        pw.println(price[0]);
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
